sentences.en: The effect of condensate supercooling degree on unit economy is analyzed and calculated quantitatively considering different connection mode of drain.

sentences.en: This "supercooling" prevents ice crystals from forming and rupturing internal organs.

sentences.en: Supercooling can occur if water is so pure and is kept in such uncontaminated conditions that the molecules have nothing to interact with and crystallize around.

sentences.en: The research on the supercooling of water is important in the fields of ice storage and cryobiology.
